newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Peptide makes Russian drug sales.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Peptide makes Russian drug sales.

text.p: Drug and pharmaceutical firm Peptide Technology Ltd said it had made the first Russian commercial sales of its psoriasis treatment, a proprietary drug called GMDP marketed in Russia as Likopid.
Peptide said the drug, initially discovered at a Moscow research institute, is being developed for use in the Western world by Peptide to treat a number of conditions but psoriasis in particular.
Negotiations were under way with a potential marketing partner with a view to accelerating Likopid's market penetration, it said.
Estimates of the worth of the total Russian pharmaceutical market range from US$3 billion to US$5 billion, Peptide said, with the market expected to double over the next five years.
By 12.25 p.m. (0225 GMT), Peptide shares were three cents higher at 87 cents on turnover of 243,300 shares.
